purpose: Route files exporting a mutating verb (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE) that resolve no request viewer, recorded as accepted debt on 2026-08-17. Each one is a write nobody can attribute. This list may only shrink: preflight raises a CRITICAL for any mutating route not listed here. Never add an entry to silence a new route — resolve the viewer and pass it to a service that fails closed without one. Session-creation endpoints are exempt in the check itself, not listed here, because they can never be repaid. See .brain/reviews/pm-triage-2026-08-17.md §S1 and §S5. 2026-08-17: the three /api/import/* routes were repaid by FR-065 (26 → 23). 2026-08-18: nineteen routes were repaid by FR-072 (23 → 4). The four that remain are NOT repayable by writing a better guard — each is a declared capability colliding with SEC-008's fail-closed rule, and each needs an owner decision that no rule currently answers. Reasons are recorded per route below and argued in full in .brain/waves/route-viewer-plan.md §BLOCKED.

blocked_reasons.src/app/api/scope/route.js: B1 — one route, seven creators. createBranch and createWorkspace(BUSINESS) are governable, but a route leaves this list only when EVERY write behind it fails closed. The other five create scope at or above the Business boundary (Portfolio, Tenant, Business, LegalEntity, and FR-020's Tenant+Business+Workspace transaction), and there is no Business to own before the Business exists. The viewer contract carries only Business-keyed grants, so no principal can hold authority above Business (SDD-037). FR-065(b)'s move — refuse for every principal — is unavailable here because it would remove FR-020's shipped เพิ่มธุรกิจ onboarding flow, live in settings/page.jsx and workspaces/page.jsx. MISSING DECISION: who may create top-level scope before FR-066/FR-067 make an above-Business authority holdable.
blocked_reasons.src/app/api/backup/import/route.js: B2 — importSnapshot deletes and replaces the entire database across every portfolio, tenant and business; previewImport reads counts across all of them. No per-Business predicate reaches it: owning every Business still leaves Portfolio/Tenant/LegalEntity/Person rows and the BR-001 isolation boundary itself ungoverned. isPlatform is not an answer either — a platform DEV grant is visibility with ownedBusinessIds empty by design, so using it would repeat the 2026-08-16 global-label-as-authority defect at platform scale. Refusing everyone would remove FR-013's shipped restore. MISSING DECISION: what authority governs a full-database restore — a holdable platform operator authority (an FR-061-shaped viewer-contract change), a device/local-session gate, or something else.
blocked_reasons.src/app/api/repositories/route.js: B3 — createRepository writes the Repository model, which carries no scope field at all: no tenantId, no businessId, no projectId (verified in prisma/schema.prisma; links live in a separate ProjectRepository row). ownsBusiness has no argument. Deriving authority from the repo's links fails OPEN, not closed: a freshly created Repository has no links, so a links-conjunction is vacuously true — i.e. 'any authenticated caller', which is a new authority rule rather than enforcement of a declared one. MISSING DECISION: what scope owns a Repository record. Likely a modelling change (give Repository an owning Tenant/Business), which would also close the cross-tenant read in listRepositories. The two /api/repositories/link routes are NOT blocked and were repaid by FR-072 — they are Project-governed.
blocked_reasons.src/app/api/repositories/[id]/route.js: B4 — updateRepository, same reason as B3.
